risks.title: Spend above the quote tier with no matching contract notice
risks.description: Indicator that general procurement spend above the quote tier may have been placed without a competitive process or a published notice. Notices are only published above the Contracts Finder level and a call-off may sit under a notice in another name, so this is a population to investigate, not a finding.

likelihood.justification: One indicator test fired for general procurement: {{$.tests.off_contract.by_tag.general_procurement.count|int}} suppliers show an annualised estimate above the tender tier with no exact notice match [metric:$.tests.off_contract.by_tag.general_procurement.count].

impact.justification: Table 1 compliance, litigation and regulatory criterion (Major): the quote and notice requirements [rule:CPR-59] [rule:CPR-60] could be unmet on spend with an annualised estimate of {{$.tests.off_contract.by_tag.general_procurement.gbp|gbp}} [metric:$.tests.off_contract.by_tag.general_procurement.gbp].

evidence: General procurement off-contract indicator: {{$.tests.off_contract.by_tag.general_procurement.count|int}} suppliers, annualised estimate {{$.tests.off_contract.by_tag.general_procurement.gbp|gbp}} [metric:$.tests.off_contract.by_tag.general_procurement.gbp]

Population to request contract and quote evidence for: {{$.tests.high_value_suppliers.by_tag.general_procurement.count|int}} general procurement suppliers above the quote tier [metric:$.tests.high_value_suppliers.by_tag.general_procurement.count]
Contract Letting audit gave Reasonable Assurance, context only [history:OP-01]
risks.proposed_focus: Request contract, quote and exception evidence for the largest general procurement suppliers with no matching notice; test against the quote rule and Appendix C exceptions.

risks.title: Split purchases and threshold-hugging payments
risks.description: Indicator that general procurement purchases may have been split or kept just below a procedure threshold, which the aggregation rules prohibit. Recurring payments also produce these patterns, so each is to be investigated.

likelihood.justification: Two indicator tests fired for general procurement: {{$.tests.threshold_clustering.by_tag.general_procurement.count|int}} payments just below a threshold [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.by_tag.general_procurement.count] and {{$.tests.split_purchases.by_tag.general_procurement.count|int}} split-purchase candidates [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.by_tag.general_procurement.count].

impact.justification: Table 1 compliance criterion (Medium): avoidance of the aggregation requirement [rule:CPR-15] and the repeat-purchase valuation rule [rule:CPR-16], with split-purchase combined value of {{$.tests.split_purchases.by_tag.general_procurement.gbp|gbp}} [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.by_tag.general_procurement.gbp].

evidence: Threshold clustering, general procurement: {{$.tests.threshold_clustering.by_tag.general_procurement.count|int}} payments worth {{$.tests.threshold_clustering.by_tag.general_procurement.gbp|gbp}} [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.by_tag.general_procurement.gbp]
The lowest tier is noisy and dominated by recurring payments [metric:$.caveats]
risks.proposed_focus: Review flagged general procurement supplier sets for a single underlying need and check how the total value was estimated.

risks.title: Spend after notice expiry or beyond the awarded value
risks.description: Indicator that spend may continue after a published contract ended, or exceed the award, without a recorded extension or variation. A newer contract may exist with no notice, and award values may be estimates.

likelihood.justification: Two indicator tests fired for general procurement: {{$.tests.expired_notice_spend.by_tag.general_procurement.count|int}} suppliers paid after every matching notice ended [metric:$.tests.expired_notice_spend.by_tag.general_procurement.count] and {{$.tests.spend_vs_award.by_tag.general_procurement.count|int}} with an annualised estimate well above the award [metric:$.tests.spend_vs_award.by_tag.general_procurement.count].

impact.justification: Table 1 compliance criterion (Medium): extensions and variations need a recorded basis [rule:CPR-70] [rule:CPR-71]; award-excess annualised estimate {{$.tests.spend_vs_award.by_tag.general_procurement.gbp|gbp}} [metric:$.tests.spend_vs_award.by_tag.general_procurement.gbp].

evidence: Spend versus award, general procurement: {{$.tests.spend_vs_award.by_tag.general_procurement.count|int}} suppliers [metric:$.tests.spend_vs_award.by_tag.general_procurement.count]
risks.proposed_focus: Obtain extension and variation approvals, or replacement contracts, for the flagged suppliers.

risks.title: Care and education placement commissioning controls
risks.description: Care and education placements, shown separately from general procurement. Indicator that placement spend above the quote tier may lack a matching notice; Appendix C row F may exempt many placements, so evidence of the basis is to be requested.

likelihood.justification: Care and education placements only: one non-recurrence indicator fired, {{$.tests.off_contract.by_tag.care_education_placement.count|int}} suppliers with no exact notice match [metric:$.tests.off_contract.by_tag.care_education_placement.count]. Repeat payment is the normal pattern here, so duplicates and clustering are not counted.

impact.justification: Table 1 compliance and financial criteria (Major): placements carry an annualised estimate of {{$.tests.off_contract.by_tag.care_education_placement.gbp|gbp}} [metric:$.tests.off_contract.by_tag.care_education_placement.gbp]; the social care exemption needs a recorded basis [rule:CPR-73].

evidence: Care and education placements, off-contract indicator: {{$.tests.off_contract.by_tag.care_education_placement.count|int}} suppliers, annualised estimate {{$.tests.off_contract.by_tag.care_education_placement.gbp|gbp}} [metric:$.tests.off_contract.by_tag.care_education_placement.gbp]
Residential and nursing care purchase audit gave Reasonable Assurance, context only [history:OP-14]
Placement providers above the quote tier: {{$.tests.high_value_suppliers.by_tag.care_education_placement.count|int}} [metric:$.tests.high_value_suppliers.by_tag.care_education_placement.count]
risks.proposed_focus: Request the commissioning basis (Appendix C row F, framework or notice) for the largest placement providers.
